nodes.label: Packaging Industry Hero — Macro Colored Plastic Film Strips
nodes.description: Macro close-up of overlapping transparent and translucent plastic film strips in vivid colors — blue, green, purple, amber, and orange — on a white background. Emphasizes the iridescent, colorful quality of masterbatch-tinted packaging films.

edges.note: Hero and card versions appear to be the same source image — identical visual content (macro colored film strips)
Both represent the packaging industry through close-up plastic film imagery
